justifications.property: 100% measured (27/27) over the files that carry per-file property targets; package-wide property coverage is not measured, so 100 records the level reached on those files.

justifications.unit: Validation and attribute-error mapping are pure logic that unit tests can drive to near-full coverage.
justifications.property: Property tests drive the provider with generated models, so near-full coverage is realistic.
justifications.guard: Guard tests run the request and context null checks, the valid and invalid validation paths and the authenticated-identity path that copies UserId and TenantId into the validation context; every line is covered.

justifications.unit: The registration method is a handful of lines that DI unit tests can cover completely.
justifications.property: Property tests build the provider through this registration, so high coverage is realistic.
justifications.guard: Guard tests run the services null check and the registration of the provider, orchestrator and pipeline behavior; every line is covered.
